items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with rebuilt or used unit
items.note: CarComplaints owners report about $6,500 at a dealer; a used gearbox from a specialist costs less.

items.t: Transfer case leaking oil or failing
items.job: Replace transfer case output seals (or the whole transfer case if damaged)
items.note: RepairPal puts a seal job at about $670-$940. A failed unit is far more; owners report up to about $6,500.

items.t: Gear selector fault and limp-home mode
items.job: Diagnose and reset or adjust J-gate selector assembly

items.t: Coolant leaks from expansion tank or thermostat housing
items.job: Replace coolant expansion tank or thermostat and housing, refill coolant
items.note: Price includes coolant. A leak diagnosis alone runs about $80-$120.

items.t: Coolant hose slipping off at oil cooler
items.job: Refit oil cooler hose with extra clamp and refill coolant

items.t: Hissing and hesitation from intake vacuum leak
items.job: Smoke test and replace intake tuning valve O-ring or manifold gaskets
items.note: The O-ring alone is quick; intake manifold gaskets take longer.

items.t: Crankcase breather valve wear causing smoke and oil use
items.job: Replace PCV (crankcase breather) valve with updated part

items.t: Misfire from failed ignition coil
items.job: Replace one ignition coil
items.note: Rear-bank coils need the intake plenum removed and take longer.

items.t: Engine stops and won't restart from corroded fuel pump wiring
items.job: Repair fuel pump connector and harness

items.t: Worn control arms and bushings
items.job: Replace front lower control arm (one side) and align
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,160-$1,460 for control arm replacement on this car.

items.t: Front knocking from sway bar links
items.job: Replace front stabilizer links (pair)

items.t: Rear turn signals stop working (recall)
items.job: Replace turn signal power module under recall

items.t: Parking brake may not hold on manual cars (recall)
items.job: Replace self-adjusting hand brake lever under recall

items.t: Manual gearbox hard to shift or clutch pedal sticking
items.job: Clean and grease clutch input splines (gearbox removed) or fit pedal return spring
items.note: The pedal spring is a quick fix. Reaching the splines means removing the gearbox, so a new clutch is often fitted at the same time.

items.t: Weak air conditioning
items.job: A/C diagnosis and compressor control valve replacement

items.t: Power steering squeal or leak
items.job: Power steering fluid additive service, or reseal or replace the rack
items.note: The additive fix is cheap. A leaking rack costs much more.

items.t: Exterior door handle stiff or not working
items.job: Replace door handle link rod or latch
items.note: One CarComplaints owner reported a much higher dealer bill.

items.t: Hard brake pedal from failing booster vacuum hose
items.job: Replace brake booster vacuum hose with check valve

items.t: Rear brake squeal or burning smell
items.job: Replace rear brake pads and clean caliper brackets

items.t: Water in passenger footwell
items.job: Clear drains, fit cowl water shield and dry carpet

items.t: Condensation inside headlights
items.job: Replace headlight low-beam rear cap

items.t: Vibration from rear driveshaft
items.job: Correct flange alignment and torque, or replace driveshaft

items.t: Airbag warning light on
items.job: Diagnose airbag system and replace faulty sensor
items.note: RepairPal lists about $450-$490 for a crash sensor and $1,830-$1,980 for the seat occupant sensor.

items.t: Alternator failure
items.job: Replace alternator

items.t: Check engine light from oxygen sensor
items.job: Replace one oxygen sensor

items.t: Key fob won't lock the car
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder
items.note: RepairPal lists about $215-$375 for ignition switch work on this car.
